ref_text: خلاص قررت أسوي لك استرجاع. رقم الطلب اثنين خمسة واحد واحد سبعة أربعة صفر. الرمز هاء صاد ياء تسعة ستة ثمانية أربعة واحد.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_v4/wavs/d2a79c0096df.wav (id najdi_v4_d2a79c0096df: in the najdi_v4 val split, which the run measured its loss on but never trained on)
notes: Joud ('Joud - Saudi Gentle & Warm', a synthesiser voice), the Najdi female support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi models trained on (9,017 of her clips, 11.6 h, nearly all Najdi). An agent confirming a refund and reading out its order number and code. It replaces, on 2026-10-06, the 6.7 s clip used until then. She has few long held-out lines: of the four of 9.5-18 s cloned with the shipped model, this is the longest of the clips that are not measurably worse than any other (two standard errors over six sentences: four short, two long); against the short clip it is level on similarity and UTMOS (-0.01), and the three longer ones lost 0.11-0.14 in UTMOS.
